Gigantic pus-white maggot. Sentient, can grant occult powers to loyal servants. If slain, inhabits a worshipper and regrows into worm body.

AC 14, HP 68, ATK 3 bite +8 (2d8 + swallow) or acid spew, MV near (burrow, fly), S +6, D +4, C +5, I +5, W +4, Ch +5, AL C, LV 14

Acid Spew. A straight line (5' wide) extending double near from worm. DEX 15+ or 3d6 damage. Organic material or metal hit dissolves on a d6 roll of 1-3.

Great Evil. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 19-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Worm regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
